settings.text: Transform your living space with our 3-Tier Oval Faux Marble Look Wooden Side Table, blending luxury and functionality in a compact footprint. The three oval shelves mimic premium white marble with realistic veining, mounted on slim gold-finished metal legs for a glamorous yet sturdy build. Ideal for narrow corners, entryways, or beside sofas, it organizes plants, mail, remotes, towels, or accessories effortlessly. The open-frame design maximizes light and airflow, preventing dust buildup, while the gold accents elevate minimalist, boho, or contemporary decor. Lightweight and no-assembly required, it's perfect for renters or quick room refreshes—add instant sophistication without overwhelming small spaces.

settings.heading: Product Specifications
settings.row_content:
• Oval Faux Marble Shelves: Three tiers with realistic white marble print for high-end look at affordable price; oval shape softens room edges.
  • Slim Gold Metal Frame: Elegant gold finish on sturdy legs adds luxury without bulk; narrow profile (under 40 cm wide typically) fits tight spots.
  • Lightweight Portability: Easy to move (under 5 kg usually); no tools needed for setup.

settings.heading: Material
settings.row_content: High-Quality Build: Powder-coated gold metal frame resists scratches; high-density faux marble tops (MDF/PVC laminate) for durability and easy clean.

settings.heading: Care Instructions
settings.row_content:
• Dust shelves/legs weekly with soft microfiber cloth; spot-clean spills with damp cloth and mild soap.
  • Avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading on marble print.
  • Indoor use only; max load per shelf to avoid warping.
